signature: fitScene(objects: Object3D[], opts?: FitSceneOptions): Promise<{position, target, distance}>

params.name: maxSafeDistance
params.desc: 防止 far plane 裁剪的最大距离

code: const roots = ssp.modelTool.getLoadedFloors().map((name) => ssp.modelTool.getFloorInfo(name)?.root).filter(Boolean); if (roots.length === 0) throw new Error('当前没有已加载模型'); return await ssp.cameraController.fitScene(roots, { view: params.view ?? 'iso', padding: params.padding ?? 1.5, maxSafeDistance: params.maxSafeDistance ?? 700, animate: params.animate ?? true });
guard: maxSafeDistance 必须 < camera.far / 1.13 (iso 视角实际距离系数)
fitScene 只调整相机；如需保存主视角，需单独执行 captureMainViewpoint
